messages:
marie: Quick sync — we need to lock the follow-on slice for the last release. Options: A) fix high-severity embed regression (customer RCA + fix), B) caching improvements (30% token cost save), C) small UX polish on convo history, D) analytics export for early access customers. Need owners + acceptance criteria by EOD.
aj: I'm +1 on A and B. A hits current support pain, B reduces cost which ops loves.
tasha: Support sees lots of noise from the embed regression — highest CSAT impact.
samir: Quick note: the caching work is medium risk (changes to prefix cache) but can be rolled out by canary in 2 weeks if we scope to single-model.
olga: UX polish is small but requires design time, maybe 3 days; not sure it beats the impact of A.
marie: Proposal: prioritize A as P0, B as P1 (single-model canary), C as P2 for next micro-iteration, D deferred unless a paying customer asks. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
aj: sounds good. can we get ownership? Samir takes B, Aj will pair on canary. Who takes A?
tasha: I'll scope A with engineering — assign to @olga? olga: I can own the embed regression triage + test plan, but need dev help for the patch.
olga: Proposed acceptance criteria for A: 1) reproduce with failing case from customer, 2) CI test added, 3) deploy patch to canary + no regression for 72h, 4) postmortem with mitigation plan.
marie: That's perfect. Put the checklist in GH issue and link here.
aj: I'll create the GH issue now and assign samir/olga/tasha. Draft checklist: 
```
- [ ] Reproduce failing embed with customer snippet
- [ ] Root cause analysis documented
- [ ] Patch PR + unit tests
- [ ] E2E regression test
- [ ] Canary deploy (10% traffic) 72h observation
- [ ] Postmortem & customer comms
```
marie: timeline ask: customer expects ETA within 3 weeks. Can we meet that?
samir: For B (cache) timeline: 2 weeks to prototype, 1 week for canary. For A, depends on root cause; if it's model input mismatch we can fix in 1 week, infra-level bug might be 3+.
tasha: I'll surface the customer SLA to legal/comms; we should aim to have a banded ETA: 1 week optimistic, 3 weeks conservative.
marie: OK — owners: A -> olga (eng + tasha support), B -> samir (eng) + aj (deploy), C -> marie for design handoff. Acceptance criteria agreed.
dev-bot: Deploy checklist created: https://ci.internal/redwood/deploy/8723 :white_check_mark:
aj: small ask — for the cache change, add a flag to switch on per-model: config snippet: `model_cache.enabled = true // per-model`. keeps rollback simple.
samir: good call. I'll make it configurable.
marie: Next steps: aj create GH issue for A (link in thread), samir create RFC for cache change, olga start triage now. We'll reconvene Friday 10am PT for checkpoints.
olga: started triage, posting initial logs in GH in 30m.
tasha: I'll draft customer comms template after we have RCA.
marie: Thanks everyone. If anything blocks, ping #eng-oncall and mention me. :raised_hands:
thread_text_snippet: Quick sync — lock follow-on slice; choose owners + acceptance criteria for embed regression, cache savings, UX polish, analytics export
